about_the_game:
With pixel-art aesthetics and dark fantasy vibes, every run presents new foes, relics, and spells to discover. Adapt your strategy, make crucial decisions, and shape your destiny with every card drawn. Will you master the arcane arts and conquer the ever-changing world of Arcanard?

Key Features: 
🔥 Roguelike deck-building – Experiment with endless card combinations and unique playstyles. 
⚡ 9 elemental powers – Build strategies around Fire, Ice, Electro, and more. 📜 Procedurally generated adventure – No two runs are ever the same. 
🎨 Pixel-art aesthetic – Immersive fantasy visuals with a dark, mysterious atmosphere. 
⚔️ Turn-based tactical combat – Outsmart enemies with careful planning.


Prepare for a thrilling, ever-evolving adventure where every decision matters. Will you rise as the ultimate elemental master?

name: Arcanard

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10 and Windows 11, 64-bit versions only.
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DRX10, DX11, and DX12-capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11/OpenGL 4.5-capable with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: Enter the mystical world of Arcanard, a roguelike deck-building card game set in a universe shaped by nine powerful elements—Strike, Fire, Water, Ice, Earth, Wind, Electro, Holy, Dark, and Chrono. Assemble your deck, master elemental synergies, and face unpredictable challenges!
